headline: $200M Phoenix Species Project aims to save 100 species from extinction
meta_description: A $200M initiative called the Phoenix Species Project is working to pull 100 species back from the brink of extinction.
summary_short: A major new initiative is funding conservation efforts to rescue 100 species teetering on the edge of extinction.
body:
A $200 million initiative called the Phoenix Species Project is working to bring 100 species back from the brink of extinction.

The project represents a significant commitment to reversing losses driven by habitat destruction, climate change, and human activity. By focusing on species at critical risk, the initiative aims to prevent extinctions through targeted conservation, research, and habitat restoration efforts.

The scale of the undertaking—both in funding and scope—signals growing recognition that extinction is not inevitable once a species nears collapse. With proper resources and coordinated action, even species on the edge can recover.
quick_facts: 100 species targeted for rescue from extinction
